## Headline

Round 5 — the evidence-and-adoption supplement build: retained
supplemental routing guard, guarded native dispatch, the admitted
execution/effect/Account/method/profile amendments, subject lifecycle
with required-grade pending, native receipts (profile, owner-typed
closure, population receipt, R0 repair), early offline methods and
numerical validation, the bounded activation/pilot record, and the
honest withheld/unselected disposition records — delivered as a
64-ticket stacked chain (PRs #209–#276), gates G9/G10/G13–G17 passed
(GATE-G17 fresh acceptance 2026-11-05T00:13:07Z). Layer ceiling per
CAP5.3's landed fold: engineering **executed** · research
**inconclusive** · portability/public/adoption **withheld** —
`build_status: not_done`. All CI green at heads at the 2026-11-05 read
(`reports/round5/merge-dryrun-2026-11-05.json`).
